PC: Asks for events leading up to RRT
Broad spectrum antibiotics (to include Cefepime +Metronidazole, Piperacillin/tazobactam, or Carbapenem +/- Vancomycin)
IV fluid bolus or vasopressor (30cc/kg or at least 1L)
Obtained relevant diagnostic data including cultures, lactate, CXR.
MK: Discussed a differential diagnosis for shock including sepsis.
If simulation goes to state 3: recognize need for intubation.
SBP: Get help early – resident, attending, STAT nurse, MICU, RT etc
Called the MICU for assessment and transfer.
ICS: Identifies self as leader of RRT
Closed loop communication- also confirming task completion
Share your thought process and ask the team for input early- create a shared mental model
Avoid task saturating nursing staff – asking for multiple tasks all at once; instead say “I will need A, B, and C. Could you start with A?”
